preconditions.description: n and k must be positive integers within the specified bounds.
n and k must have the same parity.

postconditions.description: The output string must have a length equal to n.

postconditions.expression: any(len(t) == k for t in unique_substrings(stdout))
postconditions.description: The output string must contain at least one unique substring of length k.

postconditions.expression: all(len(t) >= k for t in unique_substrings(stdout))
postconditions.description: All unique substrings of the output string must have a length of at least k.
